widths.boundary_rule: Paired zero contours of the mean signed cross-section velocity; eastward positive. Half-peak intensity domain is a different definition.
widths.extraction_method: Transcribed author-reported numerical section widths and definition; no figure or velocity array digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: HS5 at 42 W; source NECC mean section band, not one branch or a whole-current width.
widths.layer: Altimetry-derived surface geostrophic field; no fixed-depth bounds inferred.
widths.name: Atlantic North Equatorial Countercurrent
widths.range_interpretation: Published approximate mean-field section width; no error interval. Two sections do not supply seasonal or annual extrema.
remaining_gates: Independent extraction and method review; no canonical admission.
Obtain matched branch/month edge geometry before seasonal widths.
widths.section_orientation: Source cross-section component; not a reconstructed flow-normal section.
widths.source_citation: Dimoune et al. (2023), Ocean Science 19, 251-268, doi:10.5194/os-19-251-2023.
widths.source_locator: Section 3 width paragraphs after Fig. 3 discussion: NECC5/NECC6 widths and zero-contour definition; section 2.1 data/method. HTML table caption is Table 1 while prose references Table 2.
widths.source_quality_note: 0.25-degree optimally interpolated product and geostrophic assumptions limit boundary precision; ageostrophic contributions omitted. Mean band is not the width of the editorial summer route.
widths.time_convention: January 1993-December 2017 mean velocity-profile context; month precision. Not a mean of daily widths or a dated section.
